title: Whip Crack
blurb: A sharp snap, and the burn is officially certified. Cartoon logic assigned this sound to devastating comebacks decades ago and the internet has upheld the ruling without appeal ever since — it arrives immediately after somebody is thoroughly told, functioning as the audience's verdict rather than the speaker's. Timing is everything: too early and it steps on the line, too late and the moment has passed. Also entirely valid for actual whips, dramatic exits, and anyone within reach of a fedora and a leather jacket.
origin: The classic whip crack, official punctuation of burns and comebacks.
